title: Soul Feast #11: Reverence for Life: Your Soul’s Intention
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav invites listeners to explore the state of reverence – a cornerstone of authentic power and spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav invites listeners to explore the state of reverence – a cornerstone of authentic power and spiritual growth. 

Reverence is not an emotion but a state of being that allows us to see beyond the surface, into the essence of all life.

By cultivating reverence, we open ourselves to soul-to-soul connections, deepen our awareness, and align our lives with love.

Gary dives into the role of reverence, contrasting it with the old consciousness limited by five sensory perceptions. Through vivid analogies and personal reflections, he helps us understand how reverence transforms how we see others, ourselves, and life itself.

If you’re ready to embrace life with greater depth and awareness, and to create authentic power through love, this soul feast will inspire and guide you.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (01:30): What reverence truly means and how it transcends appearances to recognize the essence of life.
  • (03:25): How reverence connects to authentic power and expands our awareness beyond the five senses.
  • (06:27): Why fear obstructs reverence and how love shifts your perspective in the Earth School.
  • (11:08): The power of soul-to-soul connections and their role in spiritual growth.
  • (17:24): How reverence reshapes our understanding of life’s challenges as opportunities for growth.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take out your soul journal and reflect on your most recent soul-to-soul connection. Write about the circumstances and emotions you experienced. Then, recall and document other moments of reverence where you connected with someone’s essence, not their external “earth suit.” At the end of the week, review your entries to see how your awareness of reverence has deepened.

Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give.  Enroll in the Soul Themes course today.  Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey!
